objective: Expand the already-selected mixed representation to a complete 64-layer direct candidate before optimizer work: fit the unchanged calibration-only AFF3 attention-output algebra, pack each MLP triplet in unchanged direct CQ3_0, reproduce the authenticated pilot algebra and scores at layers 0, 32, and 63, and measure complete-block calibration NMSE at every Qwen3.8-27B text layer under one fixed gate.

scope.layer_pattern: three linear_attention blocks followed by one full_attention block, repeated sixteen times

representation.attention_input: unchanged Q4_K_M control types in the eventual complete image; exact BF16 source is retained only inside this local block screen

attention_output.fit: the original hard-forward shared-rotation and affine-codebook fit using calibration inputs only

mlp.stage: deterministic direct optimal-MSE step zero; no optimizer in this experiment

representation.all_other_tensors: unchanged from the complete Q4_K_M control in the eventual deployable image

data_protocol.source: the authenticated v42 complete BF16 block input/output shard at each layer
data_protocol.aff3_reporting_argument: the calibration matrix is deliberately supplied a second time to the legacy reporting-only validation argument; the actual internal-validation rows are never loaded into fitting or scoring
data_protocol.benchmark_contamination_forbidden: No CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, WikiText, fresh-confirmation text, or generated model output enters the direct fit or gate.

pilot_reproduction.aff3_requirement: angles plus every codes, index, anchor, and codebook payload hash must equal the authenticated pilot algebra
pilot_reproduction.cq3_requirement: all three CQ3 payload hashes per pilot layer must equal the authenticated direct pilot
pilot_reproduction.score_requirement: complete-block calibration NMSE must equal the authenticated pilot within absolute 1e-8
pilot_reproduction.purpose: detect any batch-context, source, fit, packing, or runtime drift before treating the remaining 61 layers as the same experiment

per_layer_order: authenticate the full-context shard and replay the exact BF16 block over all 12 sequences
fit or authenticate the frozen calibration-only AFF3 attention-output payload
pack or authenticate the three direct CQ3 MLP tensors
execute the mixed block over all eight calibration sequences and score exactly 64 selected rows
atomically write and authenticate one terminal layer result
execution.restart_boundary: one complete layer; a gap-free terminal result prefix defines progress and all referenced AFF3/CQ3 payloads are reauthenticated before reuse
execution.allocator_control: run garbage collection and libc malloc_trim after every terminal layer
execution.no_sweep: one representation, one fit, one row set, one layer order, and one gate are frozen

gate.failure_policy: finish the complete 64-layer denominator and seal the distribution, but admit no training if any layer fails

promotion_rules: a pass requires all 64 terminal complete-block calibration scores and exact reproduction of all three pilot payload algebras and scores
a pass admits one calibration-only all-layer training execution amendment using the already-frozen CQ3 and AFF3 hyperparameters
no failing layer may silently fall back to Q4, Q6, BF16, another bit tier, another mode, or a changed threshold
the old internal validation becomes available only after the complete 64-layer trained base candidate is frozen, and only for the already-frozen sensitivity threshold
fresh confirmation and whole-model benchmarks remain sealed
the direct screen is not a trained model, quality result, runtime result, novelty result, or scientific breakthrough
next_if_passed: Freeze a pre-execution amendment, then run the original six-step calibration-only CQ3 row-shard training followed by the original eight-step continuous-only AFF3 trust-region descent at all 64 layers. Keep internal validation and the sensitivity-gated rank-16 residual sealed until every trained base layer is terminal.
claim_boundary: A pass proves only that one fixed direct AFF3/CQ3 representation was constructed, authenticated, pilot-reproduced, and calibration-screened across all 64 Qwen3.8-27B text layers. It does not establish training success, internal-validation stability, residual benefit, a complete deployable model, end-to-end capability or speed, novelty, or a scientific breakthrough.
